decision: encode is template-off append; encode_plus applies the template and optional pair, right longest-first truncation, and right fixed padding.

decision: batch returns contiguous ids plus cumulative ends; replaces encode_batch and encode_batch_flat.

decision: vocab_size is max id + 1 including gaps and added ids; get_vocab uses raw vocab spelling; pad_token_id is [PAD] then <pad>; num_special_tokens_to_add counts the parsed template runs.

decision: count_tokens and count_tokens_batch stay template-off in both releases; both build ids, and 0.2 reuses tokenizer scratch. They are not allocation-free or early-exit.

decision: decode remains lossy text (Rust caller String, Python str); decode_bytes returns raw bytes with explicit Keep/Skip and errors unknown or gap ids.

decision: Do not revive Encoding, compat namespace, second Tokenizer, callable, old batch names, file-corpus APIs, configurable padding/truncation, typed legacy errors, or id_to_token/token_to_id aliases.
